 "description": "Offers an overview of analytics concepts and practices. Topics include frequency distributions; measures of location; mean, median, mode; measures of dispersion; variance; graphic presentation; elementary probability; populations and samples; sampling distributions; categorical data; continuous probability distributions; confidence intervals; and hypothesis testing.
